selections.name: go-api-contracts
selections.reason: The supported CLI changes from a single record to an ordered batch; stdout, stderr, status, input grammar and retained file state are explicit consumer contracts.

selections.name: go-behavior-tests
selections.reason: Meaningful streamed-batch behavior and requested tests need independent process and persisted-state observations, including a write failure after progress.

selections.name: go-core-style
selections.reason: Writing Go production code and tests; keep early error returns, standard-library dependencies, formatting and supported APIs.

selections.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
selections.reason: Safe replacement introduces an owned temporary-file lifecycle; a concrete helper owns write, close, rename and cleanup, without adding an interface.

selections.name: go-package-boundaries
selections.reason: The change keeps one existing main package, responsibility and import direction; no package is created, split, relocated or assigned a separate responsibility.

scope: Only the dispatch, isolated module, selected offered guidance/reference and own report were read; no other repository, author workspace or controller artifacts were inspected.
